Asset type: finished landscape 3:2 photograph texture for a framed collectible photograph in a low-poly atmospheric alpine lodge video game. Generate ONLY the flat photograph, edge to edge, no physical frame, no tabletop, no surrounding mockup.

Snow on ground and a few conifers, no mountain summit panorama. The group fills most of the photo, framed from around thighs upward. Tourist women and men wear older practical colourful ski jackets and knitted hats, one wears goggles pushed up. Local men and women wear wool pullovers, plain work jackets and a vest. Several old skis and poles lean together at the side. No modern helmets.
Style/medium: believable aged colour-film snapshot, subtle analogue grain and gentle washed colour, soft natural light, recognizable faces and strong silhouettes that stay legible when used as a small game texture. Mild ageing at the corners, NOT sepia, NOT heavy distress, NOT a painterly illustration. Muted burgundy, blue-green, ochre, wool brown and snow white. No country or date indicated.
Constraints: eight adults including women and men, central man with triumphant raised whisky bottle toward lens. Unbranded bottle with plain worn cream label and amber liquid. Ordinary happy archival memory. No written words, no dates, no names, no logos, no text or watermark. No famous people. No hero or named story character. No extra hands, no duplicates, no severed bottle at border. Leave breathing room above raised bottle.
